definitions.explanation: One of the three categories of Japanese honorific language ({敬語|けいご}). Polite language uses forms like です and ます to show general politeness toward the listener, without specifically elevating or humbling anyone. It is the most commonly used type of {敬語|けいご}.

examples.japanese: {丁寧語|ていねいご}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{話|はな}して→話す：00467_hanasu⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
「です」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧「ます」⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{丁寧語|ていねいご}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{代表的|だいひょうてき}→代表的：05670_daihyouteki⟧な⟦{表現|ひょうげん}→表現：03584_hyougen⟧だ。
examples.english: 'Desu' and 'masu' are representative expressions of polite language.

examples.japanese: ⟦{初|はじ}めて→初めて：02932_hajimete⟧⟦{会|あ}う→会う：00482_au⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{丁寧語|ていねいご}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{基本|きほん}→基本：00226_kihon⟧だ。
examples.english: It is standard to use polite language with someone you are meeting for the first time.

notes:
USAGE:
{丁寧語|ていねいご} is a grammatical term used in Japanese language education. It is one of the three types of ⟦{敬語|けいご}→敬語：04022_keigo⟧ (honorific language). {丁寧語|ていねいご} expresses general politeness toward the listener and is distinguished from ⟦{尊敬語|そんけいご}→尊敬語：17106_sonkeigo⟧ (which elevates the subject) and ⟦{謙譲語|けんじょうご}→謙譲語：15869_kenjougo⟧ (which humbles the speaker).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {丁寧語|ていねいご}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧ (use polite language)
- {丁寧語|ていねいご}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{話|はな}す→話す：00467_hanasu⟧ (speak in polite language)
- {丁寧語|ていねいご}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{表現|ひょうげん}→表現：03584_hyougen⟧ (polite expressions)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{敬語|けいご}→敬語：04022_keigo⟧ is the umbrella term for honorific language.
- ⟦{尊敬語|そんけいご}→尊敬語：17106_sonkeigo⟧ is respectful language that elevates the actions of others.
- ⟦{謙譲語|けんじょうご}→謙譲語：15869_kenjougo⟧ is humble language that lowers the speaker's own actions.
- ⟦{丁寧|ていねい}→丁寧：00896_teinei⟧ means polite or careful.
